outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry dot/scatter plots (gating strategy), not summary statistics like bars or means with error bars. Scatter plots inherently show individual events, so overlay of individual data points is not applicable.
Panel B consists of flow cytometry scatter plots showing gating of PC populations, displaying raw individual events rather than averaged data.
Panel C shows flow cytometry gating plots (scatter plots) of individual cell events, not averaged/summary data requiring point overlay.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay of scatter plots (each dot representing an individual cell event) comparing MBC, GC, and naive populations; it is a scatter plot, not a bar/mean plot.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots of MBC subsets, displaying individual cell events directly, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
